summary: Pelican Acquisition II Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on July 27, 2026. It sold 8,625,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including 1,125,000 units from the underwriters' over-allotment option, for total gross proceeds of $86.25 million. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-tenth of a share upon completion of an initial business combination. EarlyBirdCapital acted as sole book-running manager. The filing also covers related agreements, unregistered sales, director departures, and charter amendments. This is a routine SPAC IPO report, not a special situation; the registrant is the issuer.
